set.body:
Type: implementation or qualification task
Work key: O02.4
Program plan: docs/institutional-pilot-epics.md
Core plan: docs/core-hardening-plan.md
Accountable role (person unassigned): Operations engineer with institutional operator
Scope: Prevent staged and retained data from filling the managed volume unexpectedly.

Work kind: engineering
Acceptance gate: O02 (bd-01M4W40K6BGH2A78J8820FP8M6)
Suggested delivery tranche: T2; actual blocker graph controls readiness.

Acceptance criteria:
1. Account separately for staged, accepted, abandoned and backup bytes without double-counting content-addressed objects.
2. Reserve bounded capacity for accepted intake/export work and release reservations on completion/cancel/recovery; concurrent writers cannot oversubscribe the declared budget.
3. Refuse new work before crossing the safety reserve and emit actionable alerts; retain existing accepted bytes and keep unqualified reclamation disabled.
4. Exercise competing reservations across imports, materializations and backup/staging pressure, response loss and crash reclamation; reservations are durable/idempotent and a low-space failure never deletes accepted/shared blobs.

Verification: Concurrent reservation, restart reconciliation and low-space/disk-full tests with inventory/accounting checks.
Expected evidence: docs/evidence/institutional-pilot/O02.4/receipt.json
Evidence fields: exact source/artifact and configuration identity; commands or human procedure and observed outcomes; fixtures/data scope and environment; acceptance-criterion results, negative cases and limitations; reviewer/acceptance evidence when the task requires institutional input

Source/contracts:
- modules/service/src/main/scala/sanctity/app/ApiServer.scala
- modules/objects/src/main/scala/sanctity/objects/FileBlobStore.scala
- modules/application/src/main/scala/sanctity/application/DurableImports.scala
- docs/core-hardening-plan.md

Blocked by:
- O02.3: bd-01M4W5P8F383C1WSQ1KBH0Q6WW

Completion: satisfy every criterion with source/artifact/configuration-bound observed evidence. Integrity, unauthorized disclosure, resurrected authority or false success block release. Local engineering and simulated provider/component-loss evidence do not close real institutional/provider/human/physical-host-loss gates. Existing completed work is not reopened or relabeled by this planning revision.
set.title: O02.4: Account for storage and reserve capacity before intake
